issuer: the Commissioner of Public Safety (Motor Traffic Act 1986)
note: Read 2026-11-03 in the Motor Traffic Act 1986 (13 MIRC Ch. 1), the consolidated text the Nitijela publishes (rmiparliament.org, which had answered 403 on 2026-10-30 and 10-31). §113(1)(a): no operator's license to anyone under seventeen, so the full licence is held from 17; §115A (with §115(2A)): from sixteen, after six months on a learner's permit, a restricted license for six months, not held. §111(2): a fee of $10 for each license 'or such other fee as may be prescribed from time to time by regulation under Section 172'; no regulation prescribing another fee was found, so the Act's $10 is held. §120: valid five years (P.L. 2026-63 raised it from three). The Commissioner is the one appointed under the Public Safety Act of 1988 (the Act's definitions). No identity card and no exchange list were read.

sources.title: Motor Traffic Act 1986 (13 MIRC Ch. 1), consolidated text, Nitijela of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
sources.said: (2) A fee of $10 or such other fee as may be prescribed from time to time by regulation under Section 172 of this Chapter shall be paid to the Commissioner for each such license issued. ... (1) No operator’s license shall be issued by the Commissioner to any person: (a) who is under the age of seventeen (17) years ... §120. Term. Unless otherwise provided in this Chapter, every operator’s license issued shall be valid for five (5) years unless suspended or revoked as provided in this Part.[P.L. 1986-5, §20] [Amended by P.L. 2026-63 to increase the validity of license from 3 to 5 years]
